subject: Close-date amnesty and stage-clarity pulse - please action
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Natalie Reeves <natalie@medtechplus.com>
Date: 2027-05-18 09:12 PDT
Subject: Close-date amnesty and stage-clarity pulse - please action

Team —

Quick but important ask before we lock the quarter: we identified ~12 deals on the MDT-4839 list where the close date is >45 days out but the rep has reported the deal as committed on calls. These are causing a +$320k variance in our forecast.

Action requested (today):
- Ben: run the attached Close Date Amnesty template against your open deals in FY27 Q3 and flag anything where legal/PO is outstanding vs. the customer saying "committed". Return the sheet to me by EOD.
- Monica: prioritize a quick stage sanity check for any deals in Negotiation/Commit that have been static > 14 days — leave a short note in HubSpot explaining the blocker.

If a deal is truly committed but awaiting invoice timing, set the Close Date to the expected invoice date and put a comment with the Billing contact and expected invoice week. If the close date is speculative, move the stage back to Proposal. Our goal is to reflect economic reality for Finance.

Attachments: close_date_amnesty_template.xlsx (spreadsheet with columns: DealID, Rep, CurrentCloseDate, ProposedCloseDate, Reason, BillingContact), deal-risk-checklist.pdf

Thanks — I know this is blunt, but Finance needs line-level truth for next Tuesday's forecast.
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Natalie Reeves <natalie@medtechplus.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, salesops@medtechplus.com
Date: 2027-05-18 10:07 PDT
Subject: Re: Close-date amnesty and stage-clarity pulse - please action

Irene — thanks for the heads up and the template. Quick question on MDT-4839: our procurement team has verbally approved the PO, but legal is still redlining Section 5 (data processing). Can we mark the deal as "Committed - legal review" and leave the close date as May 31? That invoice timing is firm on our side once legal signs.

If you prefer, I can send our legal contact to yours — copied salesops@ so they can pick it up.

—Natalie
